description: FRED's own compatibility record. Researched baseline facts are kept separate from executed evidence. Schema: docs/architecture.md#compatibilityjson.

target.consequence: Board revision only matters for electrical/pin guidance; such guidance stays unresolved (C-GPIO-001).

api.notes: Version row re-read during implementation; table parsed by scripts/compare_api.py with no malformed or duplicate rows (3537 Function, 311 Variable, 319 Header rows).

sdk_artifact.consequence: Downloaded archive bytes match the published digest; its api_symbols.csv is byte-identical to the pinned firmware table (API 88.2).

ufbt_bootstrap.notes: Wheel digest matches PyPI. Bootstrap alone does not pin the build: the SDK carries much of the build machinery, and first run defaults to the moving release channel. 'ufbt update --local' also requires --hw-target=f7.

toolchain.notes: Installed by uFBT on first build; the publisher offers no checksum file, so the archive hash is observed only. A non-official toolchain changed the generated API (C-BUILD-004).

observed_non_baseline.notes: 42 added exports, no removals or signature changes relative to 1.5.1 (C-BASE-005). Informational only.

documentation_reviewed.reason: Official docs and selected third-party docs reviewed within the scope stated in the research record.

source_inspected.reason: Pinned firmware, uFBT and catalog sources inspected; every registry source URL re-resolved at its pin on 2026-10-16.

static_checks.reason: Designated fixtures: 0 compiler warnings with the official toolchain and ufbt lint (formatting/naming only) passes after ufbt format.

compiled.reason: Six designated fixtures built with uFBT 0.2.6 against the verified 1.5.1 f7 SDK and toolchain 39; APPCHK Target 7, API 88.2; no unresolved imports. Bit-for-bit reproducibility not established for multi-source apps.

host_tests.reason: Reference logic for tasks 02/03/04 passes on the fixture inputs under gcc 13.3 (ASan/UBSan) and clang 18.1 at -O0/-O2 on Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64.

device_behavior.reason: No hardware access or authorization; requires issue #9.

surfaces.notes: Guidance traced to pinned source; designated reference fixtures compiled against the verified 1.5.1 SDK with the official toolchain and their extracted logic host-tested. No device behavior verified (issue #9).
